info.title: Advance Paid Returns
info.description: API for managing advance paid returns.

get.summary: Returns a paginated list of advance paid returns. Results can be filtered by advance paid return identifier or paid advance identifier. Returns an empty page when no records match the provided filters.
get.description: Returns a paginated list of advance paid returns. Results can be filtered by advance paid return identifier or paid advance identifier. Returns an empty page when no records match the provided filters.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Defines the current page of the paginated response (starts at 1)

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Sets the maximum number of results per page (default: 50)

parameters.name: advancePaidReturnId
parameters.description:
Filter by advance paid return identifier.

**Referenced Table:** ADIANTAMENTO_PAGO

post.summary: Creates a new advance paid return record for a paid advance. Validates the paid advance reference, currency, and optional financial transaction. Verifies that the financial transaction belongs to the same establishment as the paid advance. The record identifier is auto-generated by the system.
